label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: It is impossible that there be no first mover: no…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Ergo necesse est devenire ad aliquod primum movens, quod a nullo movetur
interpretation: The existence conclusion of the prima via, stated as the reductio's double negation (classically equivalent to plain existence) so that the result needs no axioms. 'A nullo movetur' is read as being moved in no respect. The statement does not identify the first mover with God, does not assert its uniqueness, and does not assert that it is pure act.
